title: IndiaAI Safety Institute (Safe & Trusted AI pillar)
summary: MeitY announced the IndiaAI Safety Institute in January 2025 under the Safe and Trusted AI pillar of the IndiaAI Mission. It works on a hub-and-spoke model: partner institutions host IndiaAI Safety Institute cells, recruited through an expression of interest published on 9 May 2025. Its mandate covers indigenous tools, benchmarks and measurement for AI risks, India-specific governance frameworks and standards, training and awareness, and preparedness for next-generation AI systems. Under the same pillar the government reported 13 selected projects by December 2025, on machine unlearning, bias mitigation, privacy-preserving machine learning, explainability, auditing and governance testing.
beneficiaries: Academic institutions, R&D bodies, startups and government agencies as partners
